issues.correct: When only one staff person is on duty, the facility must designate another qualified staff member to be on call. Staff must also be present to evacuate nonambulatory residents at all times.
issues.evidence: OAC 3701-16-05(C)(1): 'When only one staff person is on duty in the facility, the residential care facility is obligated to designate another staff member who meets the same qualifications to be on call'. OAC 3701-16-05(C)(2)(c): staff needed to implement the evacuation plan must be present at all times.
issues.fix: Add an on-call stipend line or a second overnight staff member for the 17-bed configurations (about 15 residents, 1 overnight). Confirm that the written evacuation plan can be carried out with the overnight headcount. The 30- and 50-bed overnight headcount is not stated, so check it too.

issues.current: At least one unannounced ODH survey per 9–15 month cycle
issues.correct: ODH inspects at least once every 15 months. For an RCF with a clean record, the director may extend this to once every 30 months. The fire marshal inspects at least every 15 months.
issues.evidence: ORC 3721.02(B)(3)(a): 'By the director at least once every fifteen months, except that a home that is a residential care facility… may, at the discretion of the director, be inspected at least once every thirty months'. The statute has no 9-month floor. The 9–15 month figure was not found in the statute.
issues.fix: Change to 'ODH survey at least every 15 months (up to 30 months at the director's discretion for RCFs with no substantiated violations); fire marshal at least every 15 months.' Drop '9–15 month' unless the ODH page S1 supports it, which was not verified.

issues.correct: A two-prong definition: 17 or more unrelated individuals with personal care for at least 3, or 3 or more with personal care for at least 3 plus skilled nursing for at least 1. Homes of 3–16 adults without skilled nursing fall under a different licensing track.
issues.evidence: ORC 3721.02(A) describes a separate 'residential facility' licensed under 5119.34 for three to sixteen unrelated adults. The model's own checklist item 0 states the two-prong structure, which contradicts the key_numbers entry. issues.fix: Rewrite the key_numbers entry to match checklist item 0 (the 17-bed prong plus the 3+ with skilled-care prong). Cite ORC 3721.01 as well as OAC 3701-16-01.

issues.current: Insurance modeled at $80 per resident per month. No separate lines for unavoidable compliance costs: backup on-call pay, evacuation-staffing, annual resident-rights training, or dietitian training for therapeutic diets.
issues.evidence: OAC 3701-16-06(K) requires annual staff training on resident rights. OAC 3701-16-06(F) requires dietitian training before staff provide therapeutic diets. OAC 3701-16-06(I) bars a new hire from staying alone with residents until orientation and fire/evacuation training are done, so the hire's first days must be paid and overlapped with a trained staff member.
issues.fix: Add (1) an on-call/backup stipend; (2) paid orientation overlap hours for each new hire; (3) annual rights and fire/evacuation training time; (4) a dietitian consult fee if therapeutic diets are offered. Increase the training line (currently $200/month) if turnover is high.
